hero.descriptionPart1: I build backend systems and connect them with clean interfaces. Java, Spring Boot, and PHP on the server side, React and Angular on the client side, all with a focus on

presentacion.title: About
presentacion.textPart2: with a full stack approach. I specialize in designing scalable architectures, modeling databases, and building secure, well-documented APIs with Java, Spring Boot, and PHP. I use Docker, Postman, and Swagger as a core part of my workflow to develop, test, and document services. My frontend experience with React and Angular, combined with UX/UI design in Figma, allows me to think end-to-end solutions — understanding both server logic and user experience.

perfil.title: Profile
perfil.text: I solve complex problems with well-structured solutions. I enjoy working in teams, making informed technical decisions, and continuously learning. Growing in IT, project by project.

items.title: API built with Java
items.description: This collaborative project consists of developing an API for managing an electric scooter system, designed with a microservices architecture. The main goal is to deliver a scalable and modular solution that enables efficient management of the different system components, facilitating maintenance and evolution.

items.title: REST API Clothing Store
items.description: Development of a REST API in PHP for product management in a clothing store. The application is structured using the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architectural pattern, allowing a clear separation of concerns between business logic, data access, and route/controller management.

items.title: Clothing store frontend with Angular
items.description: Development of a clothing application where customers can register, choose products by color and size, view the total, and complete their order via WhatsApp.

items.title: AI ChatBot for reservation management
items.description: Intelligent chatbot for managing soccer field reservations via Telegram and web. It uses DeepSeek with function calling to understand natural language, validate business rules, and persist data in PostgreSQL. Web demo: https://chat-bot-front-five.vercel.app

items.title: Herramientas-Tandil store frontend (In development)
items.description: Online tool store designed to offer a fast, modern, and intuitive shopping experience. Users can browse a product catalog, view details of each tool, search by categories, and make purchases easily from a responsive and attractive interface.

items.titulo: University Technician in Computer Application Development (TUDAI)
items.lugar: National University of Central Buenos Aires Province (UNICEN)

items.descripcion: I provide independent work and services for various clients, both in technical/IT areas and in operational tasks related to gardening, construction, electrical work, and carpentry.

I gained experience in machinery maintenance and gardening/pruning tasks for various contractors. I developed autonomy, responsibility, and organizational skills in daily work, performing in dynamic and goal-oriented environments.
I developed skills in discipline, teamwork, organization, and problem solving, fulfilling operational responsibilities and adapting to different challenges with commitment and responsibility.
